title: Night Video Player - voice amp
summary: Video Player — all formats, 4K/8K with audio normalization and AI video effects
description:
Professional video player with all formats support, audio normalization, voice enhancement, video effects & video filters, IPTV/M3U playlists, AI quality boost and 4K/8K playback

Enjoy crystal-clear voice, perfect sound balance, and enhanced picture quality — all powered by smart real-time processing with Night Media Player.

🎬 ULTIMATE VIDEO PLAYER EXPERIENCE

Plays all video formats: MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, FLV, TS, M2TS, WebM, VMW, MX, HLS, 3GP & more

Supports all codecs: HEVC (H.265), VP9, H.264, MPEG-4, AV1, AC3, AAC, DTS

HD, 4K & 8K video player with full hardware acceleration

IPTV video player & M3U player – load, edit & play live streams or local lists

Subtitle support – all formats + online subtitle search

Multiple audio tracks – easily switch between languages

Android TV & Chromecast – perfect for large screens

Advanced playback tools: speed control, zoom, sleep timer, gestures, flip horizontally

🔊 SMART AUDIO NORMALIZATION & ENHANCEMENT
Your movies have never sounded this good.

Audio normalization – eliminates sudden volume jumps

Voice enhancement & amplification – clear dialogue even at low volume

Smart audio boost (up to 300%) – powerful sound on any device

Dynamic leveling – no more quiet whispers or loud explosions

Clear Voice – human voice isolation & noise reduction

Night mode – comfortable watching without disturbing others

Perfect for headphones, TV boxes, and movie lovers who care about clean sound.

🎨 EXCLUSIVE VIDEO EFFECTS, FILTERS & ENHANCEMENT
Professional video enhancer and optimizer with real-time video adjustment.

Video quality booster – make 720p look like 1080p (device-dependent)

10+ video filters and customizable effects: brightness, contrast, saturation, vibrance, sharpness, color grading, hue & more

Custom effect presets – create and save your favorite looks

Real-time GPU processing – smooth performance even on mid-range devices

Playback speed control – slow motion or fast forward with precision

Transform your videos with professional color grading and dynamic video adjustment.

📂 SMART MEDIA MANAGEMENT

Secure private folder – password-protected video storage

Favorites & History – quick access to your content

Playlist creation – organize your movies & streams

Automatic folder scan – finds all videos on your phone or SD card

External storage & third-party folders – full access everywhere

Fast and lightweight video player with hardware acceleration for ultra-smooth playback

Low battery consumption

Picture-in-Picture mode

Gesture control for brightness, volume & seeking

No ads, no tracking, no suspicious permissions

🎯 BEST VIDEO PLAYER FOR:

Movie lovers: enjoy natural sound with clear voice and beautiful picture quality

IPTV users: watch live streams with normalized, stable sound

Quality seekers: boost your visuals and sound with AI-powered enhancement

Tablet users: optimized tablet video player with perfect touch controls and large screen support

Everyone: a simple, powerful, no-ads video player that just works

Night Video Player analyzes video and audio in real-time:

Frames are processed for sharpening, upscaling, and color optimization
